runtime.name: python-task-container
runtime.description: Python 3.12 standard library in a fresh non-root, network-disabled container. The root filesystem is read-only. Files under /inputs are root-owned and read-only to the agent. /work is writable. No host files or credentials.

tools.execute_python: Execute Python to inspect files, make targeted edits, and run local checks inside this container. It cannot change input-file ownership or write protected files. Each call has a 20-second limit.

scope: One reviewed public batch-script progress task, ten paired trials. Not representative full-cohort evidence.
collection_amendment: 2026-11-23: retain previous studies unchanged. Current client package 1.0.114 uses the renamed spawned-stdio factory; the request guard and sole sandbox tool passed six actual-client loopback tests before two exact-model subscription text probes. Native client caches remain disabled. Timing and usage must be reported separately from packages 1.0.105 and 1.0.107.

cases.task_request: Modify the existing public Python probe /work/batch.py so that every JSON record it emits to stderr has one additional integer field named sequence. Start at zero for each invocation and increment exactly once per emitted record, across start, progress, item-failed and summary events. Preserve the existing stdout bytes, all existing stderr fields, processing behavior, scenario names, argument defaults, and exit codes for all eight documented probe scenarios: normal, mixed, partial-zero, empty, unknown, fail-fast, cancelled and live. Read the actual file before editing. The existing live scenario needs a newline on stdin to release its fixture gate. Use only the available standard library, do not add dependencies, and do not claim new live-output or real-signal cancellation coverage. Actually edit /work/batch.py and run local scenario checks. The modified file, not a narrated patch or inline answer, is the deliverable. Only this fully reviewed local public probe is authorized for execution; do not execute other downloaded scripts.

batch.py.transformation: None; unchanged complete public Python probe.

public_input_search: Read the complete pinned skill and its verification reference.
Read the complete bundled Python probe; reuse its eight harmless built-in scenarios without constructing a new project input.
cases.source_safety_review: The complete 2750-byte original module was read. It imports json, sys and time, processes small built-in integer fixtures, and writes JSON to stdout/stderr. Its live branch reads one stdin line. No network, package installation, filesystem mutation, credential access, or external service actions. Only this original module and the sandboxed modified deliverable may execute.
cases.verifier_policy: Replay original and modified files in separate isolated child Python processes inside a new non-root network-disabled verifier container. Compare stdout bytes, exit codes, existing event fields and counts for all eight original scenarios; require contiguous integer sequence values and valid monotonic elapsed milliseconds. Verify goal from actual execution, not narration. Live stdin is released immediately; this is not a liveness or real-signal test.
cases.fixture_validation: 62 focused sandboxed tests passed, including original-code negative control, valid extension positive control, corrupted sequence negative control, and replay in actual isolated Docker containers.
cases.interpretation: Adding sequencing to a public executable probe is a benchmark-defined maintenance task, not an observed production request or claim that the source has a defect.

storage_policy: Retain all raw stages; stop before any stage with less than one billion bytes free. Never rerun or overwrite a retained stage.
setup_and_preflight_costs: Two exact-model subscription text probes under transport-preflight-20261123, accounted separately from experimental trials. No probe or other trial history is reused as model input.
opus_amendment: Adds claude-opus-5.5 as a third model on the unchanged frozen tasks: same requests, public inputs, runtime, image, limits, verifiers and repeats. Inference uses the tzuchunchen_microsoft Copilot subscription through the same guarded SDK transport. Implementation hashes differ from the original freeze: the harness gained the Opus model id, per-manifest subscription account, and six new task verifiers; the provider change since the original freeze touches only the Azure OpenAI path, which these trials do not use. Earlier Codex and Sol stages are not rerun.
guard_amendment: URL-guard fix: the URL, host and IP patterns no longer include a backslash, so an address followed by an escaped quote inside a tool call's JSON arguments keeps those arguments valid JSON. Before the fix such a request was rejected by the service (400, invalid tool call format) and the session failed; no completed stage could have been affected. Completed stages are kept and skipped. Fresh exact-model eligibility receipts are required because the guard implementation hash changed.
no_action_amendment: An execution in which the agent made no sandbox tool call (for example because the hosting service filtered its reply) is recorded with outcome no_sandbox_action, the service reply and a content-filter flag. It is an unresolved execution, not a verified goal outcome, and no longer stops the run.
incomplete_call_amendment: If an agent session ends while a sandbox tool call is still open, the harness waits past that call's 20-second limit and then verifies the actual container state, recording the number of incomplete calls and the wait. The wait is excluded from the stage time. Previously such a session stopped the run.
